name: Bandage of Love
source:
You’re a nursing student who’s been given the opportunity to train at one of the city’s most prestigious hospitals—Greenfield Medical Center. It’s a chance to prove yourself, but the partner assigned to you turns out to be Kanade, your long-time academic rival.
Under the guidance of experienced doctors and nurses—especially the highly capable Dr. Izumi—you begin working toward your goal of securing a position at the hospital after graduation.

What seemed like a straightforward path quickly becomes more demanding. Countless lives rest in your hands, and even the smallest mistake can lead to serious consequences.

Then, patients begin to pass away under unexplained circumstances.
Faced with a situation no one can ignore, you find yourself drawn into something far more complex than you expected.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.nurseschool]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你是一名护理专业学生，有幸获得了前往全市最负盛名的医院之一——格林菲尔德医疗中心实习的机会。这本是证明自身实力的绝佳舞台，谁知分配给你的搭档，竟是多年来一直在学业上与你针锋相对的劲敌奏。
在经验丰富的医护前辈们——尤其是医术精湛的泉医生——的悉心指导下，你开始为毕业后留院正式入职的目标奋力打拼。

然而看似顺理成章的实习之路很快便变得严苛万分：无数患者的性命系于你的双手，哪怕最微小的疏忽都可能酿成难以挽回的严重后果。

就在此时，院内接连有患者在原因不明的情况下离奇身亡。
面对这桩任何人都无法坐视不管的异变，你发现自己已被卷入了一场远超想象的复杂漩涡之中。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.nurseschool]Google Play[/url]]
